units.source_text:
Wednesday morning in the same apartment. Nib sits beside the cleared reachable surface, ruler still at the bedding-side resting spot. Taeo comes to the surface with his phone, eyes going briefly to last night's finished route sheet set aside. He leaves that sheet where it is and places the phone within their shared sightline.

**CAPTION | time:** Wednesday morning.

**TAEO | speech:** Recordings first.

Nib shifts over to leave him room. No repeated negotiation or ceremonial promise.

lines.text: Wednesday morning.
Recordings first.

units.source_text:
Nib opens his RIGHT pouch with both hands, removes only his original folded sketch and reties the pouch. The five 10,000-won notes stay inside, unseen. He unfolds the sketch on the shared surface while Taeo opens Chae's existing six-entry link.

No dialogue. The old watch post, low wall, crooked tree and lower path belong to this paper, not to an image suddenly appearing on the phone.

Taeo's thumb pauses over the recognizable first-entry forked-boulder thumbnail. Nib points beside, not onto, the second entry in the same list. No magical cursor, new thumbnail grid or archive rearrangement.

**NIB | speech:** The next one. We keep coming back to that rock.

Taeo selects entry2. The first entry's closed status is unchanged but does not need another explanation.

lines.text: The next one. We keep coming back to that rock.

units.source_text:
The second recording begins on the ordinary slope-side path defined in the reference brief. The phone lies flat, face up, on the existing reachable surface between them. Both look down at its screen; use an honest overhead/oblique angle rather than a floating front-facing screen. Keep this exact placement throughout U04–12. No prop stand or supporting hand is needed. Nib compares the phone's limited view with the sketch, without a recognition gasp.

**NIB | speech:** Let it run.

Taeo takes his finger away from the playback control.

lines.text: Let it run.

units.source_text:
One modest time-compression composition of actual watching. The camera advances along the SAME lateral path; Nib's eyes move with it. Taeo stays beside him and watches too. No tapping ahead, background test planning, montage of all six entries or imagined home settlement. Only one new recording is being examined.

No dialogue. Give the footage enough visible continuity that the reader can see what it omits.

Nib pauses on the second approved path view using the learned control. His original sketch is still separate. He points to the upper frame edge, where the hillside simply leaves the camera's view.

**NIB | speech:** Can it look up there?

**TAEO | speech:** Only if whoever filmed it turned.

This is about the existing camera view, not a new archive restriction or remote camera command.

lines.text: Can it look up there?
Only if whoever filmed it turned.

units.source_text:
Nib takes his pointing hand back and restarts playback himself. Taeo resists reaching for the control. The recording continues along the path instead of obligingly changing direction. Their two faces share the composition; no shot-reverse-shot of repeated disappointment.

No dialogue. Nib gives the actual recording a chance to answer.

The final approved lateral view holds as the recording ends. Its ordinary ended-playback control follows the existing phone design; no invented duration text or error. Nib waits just long enough to see it has ended, then looks to Taeo.

**NIB | speech:** That's all?

**TAEO | speech:** That's the end of this one.

No assertion that this is all footage ever taken there.

lines.text: That's all?
That's the end of this one.

units.source_text:
Nib looks down at his original sketch, laying one finger near its lower path. Neither overlays his drawing onto the video nor claims their contours match.

**NIB | speech:** I used to look down at the path. From the post.

**TAEO | speech:** This camera stayed on the path.

Nib nods. His memory repeats established relative geography; no newly named friend, home settlement, tree species or destination.

lines.text: I used to look down at the path. From the post.
This camera stayed on the path.

units.source_text:
Taeo looks once more at the last screen view, wanting to find a useful conclusion. He asks rather than completing it for Nib.

**TAEO | speech:** Does any of it look familiar?

**NIB | speech:** Not enough. A path's a path.

The answer neither classifies a home match nor excludes the wider landscape. Do not add a concealed recognizable object for readers.

lines.text: Does any of it look familiar?
Not enough. A path's a path.

units.source_text:
Taeo takes a fresh small blank scrap and pencil from the same household supply used16, offering the pencil handle-first on the surface. Nib takes it only after Taeo lets go. This paper remains separate from yesterday's route sheet and the original sketch.

**TAEO | speech:** Want to keep where we got to?

**NIB | speech:** Yes. Leave the picture there.

The phone remains on the last view for this drawing. No perfect copying talent, literacy lesson or institutional record.

lines.text: Want to keep where we got to?
Yes. Leave the picture there.

units.source_text:
Nib draws one rough line for the visible path and a plain upper edge where the picture stops, using the actual paused view. No unseen uphill details appear. Taeo watches him leave that area blank. Keep this a single working beat, not a page-long diagram tutorial. After drawing, Nib sets the pencil down so both hands are free.

**NIB | speech:** We haven't seen above this.

**TAEO | speech:** I'll ask Chae if there's another view.

One concrete next action arises from an observed limit, not a new ability or assumed secret archive.

lines.text: We haven't seen above this.
I'll ask Chae if there's another view.

units.source_text:
Nib lifts his gaze from the paper to Taeo.

**NIB | speech:** Ask for higher up. Not another trip along the same path.

**TAEO | speech:** I'll say that.

Nib wants specific help. He is not passively grateful for whatever Taeo chooses.

lines.text: Ask for higher up. Not another trip along the same path.
I'll say that.

units.source_text:
Taeo retrieves his phone into both hands, leaving the last view only after Nib has finished the rough note. He opens the established assessment-office conversation that supplied Chae's link. No new contact search, surname, private number or unexplained attachment. He types a short question with ordinary phone keyboard motions; the full message is read aloud below rather than imposed as tiny screen text.

**TAEO | speech:** “We've looked at the second recording. Do you have another view from higher up that slope?”

This is an unsent draft so far. He is speaking to Nib, not making a phone call.

Nib lays his original watch-post sketch flat beside his new rough note and examines both, then looks up.

**NIB | speech:** Tell her I haven't found it.

Taeo stops his thumb above the send control and nods.

**TAEO | speech:** Okay.

No obligation to disclose private origin memories beyond the exact message below. No screenshot or sketch is attached.

lines.text: “We've looked at the second recording. Do you have another view from higher up that slope?”
Tell her I haven't found it.
Okay.

units.source_text:
Taeo edits and reads the COMPLETE final message aloud to Nib, at ordinary conversational speed. It may span two connected balloons in one acting unit.

**TAEO | reading message:** We've looked at the second recording in the six you sent. Nib hasn't found his watch post. Does that survey have another view from higher up the slope?

Nib listens through the end. This exact wording is the entire diegetic message. Do not append a request for a fresh draw, route access, research priority, meeting, diagnosis or special permission.

Nib gives a small nod. Taeo presses send once and lowers the phone to the shared surface, screen no longer framed for readable content. The action completes the request through the already existing contact. No typing indicator, read receipt, instant reply or promise that Chae possesses the footage.

**NIB | speech:** That.

No other dialogue. Sending a fictional message inside this script is not an instruction to contact a real person.

lines.text: We've looked at the second recording in the six you sent. Nib hasn't found his watch post. Does that survey have another view from higher up the slope?
That.

units.source_text:
Nib refolds the original sketch along its old folds and puts only that sketch back into his RIGHT pouch, then reties it. The new partial-view note stays on the surface. Taeo starts to reach for the phone again, checks himself and leaves it lying where a reply can arrive normally.

**NIB | speech:** She won't answer faster if you pick it up.

**TAEO | speech:** I know.

His hand comes back empty. Let the dry joke belong to their present habits, not omniscience about Chae's timetable.

lines.text: She won't answer faster if you pick it up.
I know.

units.source_text:
With the search session actually finished, Taeo brings yesterday's rough exit sheet back to the near side of the surface. He does not move Nib's new note out of the way; he leaves it its own clear space. He looks at the uncertain dogleg spacing, then takes a THIRD small clean scrap for his own proposed next step. The old map is evidence, not a form to submit.

**TAEO | speech:** I want to ask Minho for another ground practice.

**NIB | speech:** With the radio?

**TAEO | speech:** Yes. Nothing through a gate.

This is a proposal only. No booking, issued equipment or promise of paid work.

Taeo draws a plain box on the new proposal sheet and indicates the unused space beyond it with the pencil. No dungeon, replica course, engineering dimensions or apparent new building is depicted.

**TAEO | speech:** A route I haven't watched you walk. I draw what you tell me. Then we check it.

Nib looks at the little box, then at the question mark on yesterday's sheet.

**NIB | speech:** Check it with what?

lines.text: I want to ask Minho for another ground practice.
With the radio?
Yes. Nothing through a gate.
A route I haven't watched you walk. I draw what you tell me. Then we check it.
Check it with what?

units.source_text:
Taeo begins to answer, stops, then sets the pencil down so he can explain with his hands without drawing a fake result.

**TAEO | speech:** I hadn't got that far.

**NIB | speech:** Carrying something changes the turn. We found that out.

Nib refers to the actual empty-frame check; he does not prescribe moving a person, unsafe loads or site borrowing. Keep the exchange matter-of-fact, without a gotcha grin.

lines.text: I hadn't got that far.
Carrying something changes the turn. We found that out.

units.source_text:
Taeo considers the question mark once more. He picks up the pencil and leaves a short ordinary note to himself on the proposed practice page. Exact native lettering is unnecessary; his speech supplies it.

**TAEO | speech:** Ask Minho what we can safely use. Something empty.

**NIB | speech:** And who has to walk beside it.

**TAEO | speech:** That too.

This incorporates the13 four-carrier-footprint lesson without establishing untrained carry expertise. The request remains unsent and no design or test protocol is approved here.

lines.text: Ask Minho what we can safely use. Something empty.
And who has to walk beside it.
That too.

units.source_text:
Nib gets the folded ruler from its safe bedding-side spot with RIGHT and sets it beside HIS partial-view drawing, clear of the phone and Taeo's paper. He does not offer it as payment, a gift, a permit to train him, or evidence that he has joined a guild.

**NIB | speech:** If Minho agrees, I want to see it before we start.

**TAEO | speech:** You will.

Specific conditional involvement, not a standing commitment. Taeo has not recruited a free assistant for his career.

lines.text: If Minho agrees, I want to see it before we start.
You will.

units.source_text:
Final ordinary wide of the small room. Taeo gathers his old route sheet and proposed practice note together without taking Nib's partial-view drawing. Nib rests his hands beside his own folded ruler and note; his personal sketch is safely back in his tied pouch. The phone lies between their separate work, silent. Neither stares at it. No glowing object, unseen reply, new quest UI or forecast of another companion.

**TAEO | speech:** I'll ask about the practice after she answers.

**NIB | speech:** You can ask. Just don't lose my place.

Taeo leaves Nib's drawing where he can find it. End on Nib making room for Taeo's ambition while keeping his own search visible. The two requests need not depend on one another; only Chae's question has actually been sent.

lines.text: I'll ask about the practice after she answers.
You can ask. Just don't lose my place.
